;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[2020 Vienna attack]], [[Islamic terrorism in Europe]]
**Through its [[Amaq News Agency]], the [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant]] claims responsibility for last night's deadly [[mass shooting]] in [[Vienna]], [[Austria]]. [https://de.reuters.com/article/uk-austria-attacks-claim-idUKKBN27J2FA (Reuters)]

;Business and economy
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
**[[Economy of Australia]]
***The [[Reserve Bank of Australia]] slashes its official cash rate to a historic low 0.1%, in an attempt to boost spending in the [[Economy of Australia|economy]] and address the high rate of [[unemployment]] caused by the [[COVID-19 pandemic]]. It is also expected that the cash rate will not go up for at least another three years. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2020/nov/03/reserve-bank-australia-interest-rates-rba-slashes-cash-rate-historic-low-australia-economy (''The Guardian'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hungary]]
****[[Hungary]] reports 3,989 new infections and 89 deaths in the past 24 hours, its single-day record on both cases and deaths since the [[pandemic]] began, bringing the nationwide totals to 86,769 cases and 1,973 deaths respectively. [https://hungarytoday.hu/hungary-record-covid-deaths-new-cases-tuesday/ (Hungary Today)]
****[[Prime Minister of Hungary|Prime Minister]] [[Viktor Orbán]] declares a [[state of emergency]] (known as a "special legal order") for the second time beginning at midnight due to a resurgence of COVID-19 in the country and would ask lawmakers to extend it for another 90 days. He also orders bars and entertainment venues to close and imposes a nighttime curfew between midnight and 5:00 a.m. local time. [https://bbj.hu/coronavirus/govt-to-declare-special-legal-order-introduce-night-curfew_191508 (Budapest Business Journal)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in France]]
****[[France]] reports 854 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, which is the highest number since April 15, with more than half coming from nursing homes. [https://english.alarabiya.net/en/coronavirus/2020/11/03/Coronavirus-Coronavirus-France-reports-854-COVID-19-deaths-36-330-new-infections- (Al-Arabiya English)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Italy]]
****[[Italy]] reports 353 new fatalities in the past 24 hours, the highest number of fatalities since May. [https://www.ansa.it/english/news/general_news/2020/11/03/covid-353-victims-over-28000-new-cases_6bb7a057-0637-4cf6-814b-810a98b8ff49.html (ANSA)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Netherlands]]
****[[Prime Minister of the Netherlands|Prime Minister]] [[Mark Rutte]] announces additional restrictions, closing theatres, cinemas, museums and zoos for two weeks beginning at 10:00 p.m. local time tomorrow. He also advises people to stay at home and only go outside if necessary. In addition, the maximum amount of people who can meet outside is reduced from four to two. [https://www.dutchnews.nl/news/2020/11/tougher-coronavirus-rules-for-two-weeks-and-rotterdam-may-face-full-lockdown/ (Dutch News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland]]
****[[Poland]] surpasses 400,000 cases of COVID-19. [https://www.jpost.com/breaking-news/polands-total-number-of-coronavirus-cases-exceeds-400000-647859 (''The Jerusalem Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Romania]]
****[[Romania]] records 7,733 new cases, as well as 120 deaths. It is the highest jump in the number of cases and the deadliest day since the start of the [[pandemic]] in the country. [https://www.romaniajournal.ro/society-people/health/romania-close-to-8000-new-covid-19-cases-per-day-record-high-on-deaths-and-patients-in-intensive-care/ (''Romanian Journal'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Bahrain]]; [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Bahrain]] grants emergency use approval for a [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] candidate produced in a partnership between [[Sinopharm]] and [[Abu Dhabi]]-based artificial intelligence and cloud computing company Group 42 on frontline workers. [https://www.reuters.com/article/health-coronavirus-bahrain-int-idUSKBN27J153 (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia (country)|COVID-19 pandemic in Georgia]]
****[[Georgia (country)|Georgia]] imposes additional restrictions which require people to wear masks outdoors as well as indoors, all restaurants and cafés must close at 10:00 p.m. local time, and remote learning at schools and universities in 10 large cities, including [[Tbilisi]], will continue until November 25. [http://georgiatoday.ge/news/22910/New-Decisions-of-Georgian-Gov%27t-Related-to-Coronavirus- (Georgia Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Iran]]
****[[Iran]] reports 8,932 new cases, its single-day record, pushing the case total to 637,712. [https://www.arabnews.com/node/1757941/middle-east (''Arab News'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 12 new fatalities in the last 24 hours, bringing the nationwide death toll from the virus to 263. [https://www.nst.com.my/news/nation/2020/11/637786/malaysia-sees-record-12-covid-19-deaths-1054-new-cases (''New Straits Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
****[[Nepal]] surpasses 1,000 COVID-19 deaths. [https://kathmandupost.com/health/2020/11/03/nepal-s-covid-19-death-toll-surges-past-1-000-with-20-more-fatalities-in-the-past-24-hours (''The Kathmandu Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in United Arab Emirates]]
****[[List of prime ministers of the United Arab Emirates|Prime Minister]] and [[Ruler of Dubai|ruler]] of [[Dubai]], Sheikh [[Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum]] received the COVID-19 vaccine developed by [[Sinopharm]]. Front-line healthcare workers in the UAE are also getting the shot as part of emergency use authorization. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2020/11/3/uae-pm-and-dubai-ruler-receives-coronavirus-vaccine (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Maine]]
****[[Maine]] reports 127 new infections on [[Election Day (United States)|Election Day]], its single day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.pressherald.com/2020/11/03/on-election-day-maine-sees-record-127-cases-of-covid-19/ (''The Press Herald'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Minnesota]]
****[[Minnesota]] reports 3,483 new infections, its single day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.duluthnewstribune.com/newsmd/coronavirus/6746449-Minnesota-sets-new-record-with-nearly-3500-cases-on-Election-Day (''Duluth News Tribune'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]]
****[[Pennsylvania]] reports 2,875 new infections, its single day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.inquirer.com/health/coronavirus/covd19-record-cases-election-surge-chop-pennsylvania-20201103.html (''The Philadelphia Inquirer'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Wisconsin]]
****[[Wisconsin]] reports more than 5,700 new infections, its single day record since the pandemic began. [https://www.jsonline.com/story/news/2020/11/03/wisconsin-coronavirus-state-reports-5-700-new-cases-52-deaths/6145913002/ (''Milwaukee Journal Sentinel'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Algeria]]
***[[President of Algeria|President]] [[Abdelmadjid Tebboune]] tests positive for COVID-19 but his condition is gradually improved as he receives treatment in a [[Germany|German]] hospital, according to a statement from the presidency. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2020-11-03/algeria-s-president-diagnosed-with-coronavirus-ennahar-reports?utm_source=google&utm_medium=bd&cmpId=google (Bloomberg)]

;International relations
*[[Australia–China relations]]
**[[China]] is threatening to impose bans on up to [[Australian dollar|$]]6 billion of key Australian exports such as wine, copper, barley, coal, sugar, timber and lobster beginning Friday, straining trade relations between the two countries. [https://www.afr.com/world/asia/china-targets-6-bln-of-australian-exports-in-fresh-coercian-campaign-20201103-p56ayx (''Australian Financial Review'')]
*The United States, Japan, India and Australia begin the [[Malabar (naval exercise)|Malabar naval exercise]], in what is seen as a push to counter China's military and economic power in the region. Meanwhile, China has accused the United States of having a "[[cold war]] mentality" and "ideological prejudice". [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-india-navy-drills/india-u-s-japan-and-australia-kick-off-large-naval-drills-idUSKBN27J11Z?il=0 (Reuters)]

;Law and crime
*[[Thailand]] bans [[pornography]] website [[Pornhub]] and 190 other websites depicting pornographic material and gambling, which are [[Internet censorship in Thailand|illegal under Thai law]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/11/03/asia/thailand-porn-ban-protest-scli-intl/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 United States elections]]
**[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 United States election protests]]
***[[Americans]] head to the polls to vote for their [[President of the United States|President]] and [[Vice President of the United States|Vice President]]. Around 100 million Americans have already voted [[Early voting|early]] or [[Postal voting in the United States|by mail]] due in part to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/live/2020/11/02/us/trump-biden-election (''The New York Times'')]
***Demonstrators and supporters of both President [[Donald Trump]] and former Vice President [[Joe Biden]] gather at [[Black Lives Matter Plaza]] in [[Washington, D.C.]] A fight breaks out which results in one arrest. [https://www.nbcwashington.com/news/local/washington-dc-2020-election-day-night-protests-demonstrations/2461783/ (NBC)]
***Voters in [[Arizona]], [[New Jersey]], [[Montana]] and [[South Dakota]] approve legislation legalizing [[recreational cannabis]], while voters in [[Mississippi]] approve the medical use of cannabis. [[Oregon]] becomes the first U.S. state to decriminalize the possession of small amounts of [[hard drugs]] such as [[cocaine]], [[heroin]] and [[methamphetamine]]. [https://eu.usatoday.com/story/news/politics/elections/2020/11/04/recreational-weed-legal-arizona-new-jersey-south-dakota-montana/6160708002/ (''USA Today'')]
***The legalization of [[sports betting]] is approved by voters in [[Louisiana]], [[Maryland]] and [[South Dakota]]. [https://www.espn.com/chalk/story/_/id/30256229/voters-louisiana-maryland-south-dakota-approve-sports-betting (ESPN)]
**[[2020 Puerto Rican status referendum]]
***Voters in [[Puerto Rico]] vote on whether they wish to be a state or not. If voters [[Statehood movement in Puerto Rico|decide on statehood]], the territory could work to [[51st state|join the union]] and fully become incorporated into the United States. [https://www.businessinsider.com/puerto-rico-statehood-referendum-live-results-2020 (''Business Insider'')]
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on politics]]; [[COVID-19 pandemic in Denmark]]
**The [[Folketing]] (Danish Parliament) suspends voting and other meetings after several lawmakers tested positive for COVID-19 and six ministers had self-isolated while awaiting test results. [https://www.swissinfo.ch/eng/danish-parliament-suspends-voting-after-several-lawmakers-test-positive-for-covid-19/46137994 (Swiss Info)]
*[[2020 Palauan general election]]; [[2020 Palauan presidential election]]
**[[Palauan people|Palauan]]s elect their new [[President of Palau|President]]. Outgoing president [[Tommy Remengesau Jr.]], who completed his [[term limit]], will be succeeded either by his brother-in-law [[Surangel Whipps Jr.]] or current [[Vice-President of Palau]] [[Raynold Oilouch]]. Aside of the president, the electorate also votes for the members of the country's [[Palau National Congress|National Congress]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/429766/palauans-vote-on-new-political-era (RNZ)] [https://foreignbrief.com/daily-news/general-elections-will-be-held-in-palau-to-elect-a-president-and-the-national-congress/ (Foreign Brief)]
*[[2020 Ivorian presidential election]]
**Incumbent president of the [[Ivory Coast]] [[Alassane Ouattara]] is declared the victor of the latest presidential election which has been boycotted by the political opposition as a third term for Ouattara was deemed unconstitutional. The election was overshadowed by deadly clashes with at least 30 casualties. [https://www.dw.com/en/ivory-coast-election-ouattara-wins-third-term-opposition-cries-foul/a-55480568 (DW)]
